head: b88ff916d
summary: Every finding the fix report claims fixed is fixed on the current head (b88ff916d), independently re-verified by reading the code, re-executing the review's own probe, and re-running the full gate chain — not by trusting the report's narration. ADV-01 (blocker): re-ran the fix worker's own rolled-back-transaction probe (adv01.mjs) fresh on clara_l03 and confirmed both branches — the recognised pre-image and a sibling lane's arm applied first at a lower migration number — compose, that the reconstructed pre-image hashes to 0302's own pin, that 0302+0304 replayed from it reproduce the live body byte for byte, and that the live body was unchanged and clara.skip_plan_occurrence was restored after rollback. Read packages/db/migrations/0302_accrual_bill_conflict.sql:143-259 directly and confirmed the prestate is now bimodal (pinned sha OR structural admission on the two CTE seams) rather than a hard sha pin. ADV-02/ADV-03/ADV-04/SPEC-02/SPEC-03/SPEC-05/ADV-08 (DB half): re-ran packages/db/tests/accrual-bill-conflict.test.mjs (15/15, up from 9), accrual-revenue-side.test.mjs (9/9, up from 8) and accrual-period-amounts.test.mjs (12/12) against clara_l03 myself; read each new cell's body (p938.remedy.reverse_now_leaves_one_expense, p938.remedy.skip_is_about_the_NEXT_period, p938.read.plan_not_active, p938.read.per_period_amount, p942.conflict.issued_invoice) and confirmed each drives the real door/lane it claims (skip_plan_occurrence, request_plan_catch_up, end_accounting_plan, pause_accounting_plan, admit_trade_invoice_work) and asserts the ledger/queue state described, not a narrated claim. STD-942-01: read packages/db/migrations/0304_accrual_revenue_side.sql:1479-1483 and confirmed the has_function_privilege block for clara.list_accrual_adjustments(uuid,date,date) now sits beside the other two door checks, and apps/web/tests/firm-scope-db-pins.corpus.ts's 0304 entry now claims and its sha256 (95c8bdd5...) matches the actual file hash. SPEC-01/SPEC-06/SPEC-07/ADV-05/ADV-06 (web half): read apps/web/components/firm/accrual-bill-conflict-affordance.tsx and confirmed it renders the side, the flagged period, a journalEntryHref link from row.entry_id, a remedy hint, and the ended/paused plan-status face with no dead controls; confirmed apps/web/components/accruals/accrual-bill-conflicts.tsx now mounts that same component (64 lines, down from 153, duplication removed) rather than carrying its own copy of the state machine; confirmed en.json's billConflictsHeading/Body, NeedsYou.rowKinds.accrual_bill_conflict and accrual-form.tsx's rule-dependent methodHint are all reworded to be true on both sides. Re-ran the new component test file (accrual-bill-conflict-affordance.test.tsx, 5/5) and accrual-form.test.tsx (21/21) directly. Re-ran the whole apps/web unit suite (5025 tests, 5023 pass, 0 fail, 2 known skips — exact match to the fix report), pnpm typecheck (exit 0), CI=true GITHUB_ACTIONS=true pnpm lint (exit 0), node scripts/check-frozen-workflows.mjs (OK, 312 frozen files, no manifest diff), node scripts/migrate.mjs on clara_l03 (0 new, 292 total, no checksum drift, and the ledger checksums for 0302/0303/0304 match the files' actual sha256 byte for byte), accrual-adjustments.test.mjs (21/21), operation-census.test.mjs (10/10), rig-isolation.test.mjs (22 pass, 1 correctly-gated skip), and the lane's own Playwright triple (pnpm --filter @clara/web e2e accrual-walk, 20/20 on 3520/3521/3522). Everything matches the fix report's own numbers exactly, and nothing else broke. The items the fix report deliberately leaves open (SPEC-08 zh, SPEC-09 the remainder-rule owner reading, ADV-07 the dedupe-hash note, the mysterious-name account-code-rename note) are all minor or note severity, each with a sound stated reason re-verified against the code (apps/web/messages/ still holds en.json alone; the two cells pinning the remainder-rule boundary are still present and green), so nothing above minor remains and the round is accepted.
